description: Measured, digest-pinned AI-fit inputs for the AQ-OS installer golden path. Data only; the recommended/limited/not_advised verdict is computed deterministically by scripts/ai/lib/ai_fit.py from this catalog + a versioned hardware-evidence summary. No model table or threshold is embedded in the install-plan schema or the hardware detector (PRD v2 section 92).

reference_measurement.machine: AMD Renoir APU (Ryzen 4x00), 4GB shared VRAM, 27GB usable RAM
reference_measurement.notes: n_gpu_layers ceiling 12 (4GB shared VRAM); current resident model qwen3.6-35b-a3b Q5_K_S ~24GB is tight and swaps under load. Reserves below are the measured UMBM split from CLAUDE.md Architecture Constraints.

reserves.source: aq-os Renoir reference box UMBM: 3.0GB OS reserve + 1.0GB KV floor measured (CLAUDE.md); 2.0GB recommended_headroom is a conservative policy margin (unmeasured, deliberately generous).

cpu.source: config/hardware-capability-matrix.json: universal GGML fallback, no GPU dependency.

vulkan.source: config/hardware-capability-matrix.json (Mesa RADV/ANV) + aq-os measured Renoir 4GB-shared n_gpu_layers ceiling=12. Partial offload for APUs; full for discrete.

cuda.source: config/hardware-capability-matrix.json: NVIDIA CUDA full offload, requires known discrete VRAM.

rocm.source: config/hardware-capability-matrix.json: AMD ROCm promotion_gated/unstable -> not auto-selected in P0; discrete AMD falls back to vulkan.

models.notes: medium; fits 27GB RAM cpu-first; cpu 3-7 tok/s.
medium MoE (A3B active); cpu 15-30 tok/s; strong RAM-only value.
large; aq-os reference-box model family; cpu 2-4 tok/s; 24GB Q5 resident is tight.
